name: Facet
text: Ship a real-time contrast checker that overlays the dark theme’s text and background directly in the interface. This forces the team to fix contrast issues before submission, cutting rework and ensuring visibility. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in editing speed, but clarity and enjoyment for users outweigh it.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The real risk is training users to ignore the contrast problem—once they see the c | overlay flicker, they’ll learn to tolerate it, not fix it. A pre-submission block risks drop-off; a live checker risks habituation. Settle it with A/B testing: half the users get the overlay, half get a hard block at submission—measure both drop-off and post-submission fixes.
